documents.title: Project Overview
documents.summary: A home document for the custom Forever Bound lore editor.
documents.content:
Forever Bound Lore Workspace

This workspace is a lightweight browser-based editor for long-form worldbuilding, interconnected lore, and episode planning.

Goals

  • Fast document switching without page reloads.
  • Autosaved rich-text editing.
  • Searchable structured lore metadata.
  • Portable HTML/JSON content that can live directly in the repository.

Use internal references like [[Episode 01]] or [[Ironvale]] to mark future links between lore documents.
